insurer: Raheja QBE General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses up to 1% of Sum Insured per day; proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges up to 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern Treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured; ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

initial_waiting.note: 30 days for all illnesses except accidents; 90 days for lump-sum HIV/AIDS benefit

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability and HIV/AIDS; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, varicose veins, calculi, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonus mentioned in claim assessment order but no rate or cap defined in policy wording

restoration.note: Replenish/Recharge of Sum Insured referenced in claim assessment clause but no benefit defined in policy wording

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; extensive indicative list of 537 procedures provided

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured and related complications explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic, oral chemo, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Extensive non-payable consumables list (Annexure II List I) explicitly excluded; gloves, masks, etc. not covered

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/non-monthly modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not renewals

portability.note: Portability to same product with other insurers; migration within company also allowed (product withdrawal only)

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary treatment, overseas treatment, organ donor, STDs, stem cell storage, experimental therapies, congenital external defects, OPD
